rejections: NX18 offline Horizon process rewriting cannot substitute for a full macOS kernel/software MMU.
Forcing apple-a20 ISA on the M4 is the wrong CPU target; off-label AudioWorkInterval and private core pinning are not used.
Tessellation, indirect command buffers and opaque queries without verified Metal4 mapping retain their complete encoder unit on the classic GPU; unrelated supported units use ordered Metal4 replay.
Unrelated game archives cannot precompile Safari/Roblox guest shaders; only known Henge display pipelines are bundled.
Persistent guest framebuffers/heap allocations retain exact backing identity; transient recycling never replaces live content.
Mixed classic resource uploads/readback and Metal4 require two-way GPU ordering. Unverified removal of these dependencies is rejected.
